versions.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud Bastion Host Network Diagnosis skill.

- Diagnose connection timeouts and access anomalies to Bastion Host, guiding users through checks of public network connectivity, instance configurations, Cloud Firewall rules, and related issues.
- Strict compliance: all operations are read-only, all cloud API calls use aliyun-cli, and user credentials are never exposed or persisted.
- Automatically collects pre-diagnosis info, prioritizes user consent, and stops execution if environment issues or insufficient permissions are detected.
- Specialized handling for private domain names and scenarios involving Cloud Firewall, cross-border access, or missing instance info, always using required Alibaba Cloud diagnostic terminology in responses.
- Ensures all commands are run as single-line scripts, and every diagnostic report clearly states the instance ID and region in the user's language.
